claims.note: F1: generic clinical "we" (بررسی می‌کنیم) describes standard practice, not a personal-opinion marker of the listed kind (به نظر من, تجربه‌ی من, فکر می‌کنم...); a present-tense practice/recommendation stays attributed, so not AUTHOR_VIEW. F2 under FULL_TEXT: the predicate is order of examination on a radiograph (one of the FIRST things checked); the source says CRR is one of the PRIMARY variables (importance) in judging abutment suitability, and separately that CRR is determined radiographically and should use periapical films. Same subject, different predicate = neighbouring proposition (F2 near-miss 2), silence, not MATCHES. No source sentence states CRR is checked first/early on radiographs.

claims.source_quote: The CRR represents the biomechanical concept of Class I lever for evaluating abutment teeth.

claims.claim_quote: وقتی استخوان تحلیل می‌ره، طول بازوی بیرونی اهرم بیشتر و طول بازوی مقاوم کمتر می‌شه.
